description: Generate an IBAN for testing from an ISO-2 country code, bank code and account number. Required parameters: countrycode, bankcode, accountnumber. Counts as one IBAN-Test API request. Authentication is required for execution; anonymous clients may discover this tool. Register or log in to create an API key: https://www.iban-test.eu/Registration. Configured free limit: 10 API requests per 24-hour period.

countrycode.description: ISO-2 country code, for example DE.

name: generate_test_iban
